titulo: Using ni… ni… for neither… nor…
subtitulo: Ni Beto ni Lucas vinieron / no vinieron ni Beto ni Lucas.
regla: Ni… ni… = neither… nor, before each element. Before the verb: no extra no. After the verb: no before the verb (no vino ni Beto ni Lucas).

bloques.texto: To say _neither… nor…_, use **ni** twice, once before each negative element.
**Ni** can go before nouns, verbs, adjectives, and more: **ni estudia ni trabaja**, **ni bueno ni malo**.
If **ni… ni…** comes **before** the verb, the verb takes no **no**. If it comes **after** the verb, the verb needs **no** before it. Both mean the same.

filas: Ni Lucas ni Daniel fueron a la fiesta.
No fueron a la fiesta ni Lucas ni Daniel.

bloques.texto: The double negative stays negative in Spanish.
Tip: two **ni**s are two closed doors.

lista.es: ==Ni== Lucas ==ni== Daniel fueron a la fiesta ayer.
lista.en: Neither Lucas nor Daniel went to the party yesterday.
He's kind of lazy: he neither studies nor works.

lista.es: Su español no es ==ni== bueno ==ni== malo.
lista.en: His Spanish is neither good nor bad.

lista.es: Ayer ==no== fueron a la fiesta ==ni== Lucas ==ni== Daniel.
lista.en: Neither Lucas nor Daniel went to the party yesterday.

lista.es: ==No== le interesa ==ni== la historia ==ni== la geografía.
lista.en: She's interested in neither history nor geography.

lista.es: ==Ni== sentado ==ni== acostado se me quita el dolor de espalda.
lista.en: Neither sitting nor lying down does my back pain go away.

filas.t: Ni Beto ni Lucas no vinieron.
No vinieron ni Beto ni Lucas.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Neither the bus nor the taxi came._
lista.r: Ni el camión ni el taxi llegaron.

lista.p: Same idea with **no** before the verb.
lista.r: No llegaron ni el camión ni el taxi.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I neither drink nor smoke._
